title: Android plugin: 4.6.1 RC1: Wrong convertion Dictionary with Integer to Long
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.6.1 RC1
- Not reproducible in: 4.5.1 stable 

### System information

Windows 11 - Godot v4.6.1 RC1 - Compability - Radeon Graphics 

### Issue description

Main issue: https://github.com/poingstudios/godot-admob-android/issues/270 

After fixing https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/115669, I've encontered another which relates when trying to get an Integer value from a Dictionary, it tries to convert to Long and causes an Exception.

### Steps to reproduce

- Create an Dictionary and call the plugin method such as: 
```gdscript
var ad_view_dictionary := {
	"ad_unit_id": ad_unit_id,
	"ad_position": 0,
	"ad_size": {
		"width": ad_size.width,
		"height": ad_size.height
	}
}
_uid = _plugin.create(ad_view_dictionary)
```

- On Android Plugin, try to use the Dictionary "ad_position" value as Int 
```kotlin
@UsedByGodot
fun create(adViewDictionary : Dictionary) : Int{
    val banner = Banner(banners.size, activity!!, aGodotLayout, godot, pluginName, adViewDictionary).apply {
        banners.add(this)
    }

    return banner.uid
}


class Banner(
    uid: Int,
    activity: Activity,
    godotLayout: FrameLayout,
    godot: Godot,
    pluginName: String,
    adViewDictionary: Dictionary
) : AdFormatsBase(uid, activity, godot) {
    private var safeArea = getSafeArea()
    private val adPosition: Int = adViewDictionary["ad_position"] as Int
...

```

Error: 
```
02-07 21:23:00.568  5026  5244 E poing-godot-admob: java.lang.ClassCastException: java.lang.Long cannot be cast to java.lang.Integer
02-07 21:23:00.568  5026  5244 E poing-godot-admob:     at com.poingstudios.godot.admob.ads.adformats.Banner.<init>(Banner.kt:55)
02-07 21:23:00.568  5026  5244 E poing-godot-admob:     at com.poingstudios.godot.admob.ads.PoingGodotAdMobAdView.create(PoingGodotAdMobAdView.kt:76)
02-07 21:23:00.568  5026  5244 E poing-godot-admob:     at org.godotengine.godot.GodotLib.step(Native Method)
02-07 21:23:00.568  5026  5244 E poing-godot-admob:     at org.godotengine.godot.gl.GodotRenderer.onDrawFrame(GodotRenderer.java:61)
02-07 21:23:00.568  5026  5244 E poing-godot-admob:     at org.godotengine.godot.gl.GLSurfaceView$GLThread.guardedRun(GLSurfaceView.java:1604)
02-07 21:23:00.568  5026  5244 E poing-godot-admob:     at org.godotengine.godot.gl.GLSurfaceView$GLThread.run(GLSurfaceView.java:1306)
```

Full dict value: `02-07 21:23:00.568  5026  5244 D poing-godot-admob: dict: {ad_unit_id=ca-app-pub-3940256099942544/2934735716, ad_position=0, ad_size={width=392, height=61}}`

Original classes:
- https://github.com/poingstudios/godot-admob-android/blob/v4.0.0/src/ads/src/main/java/com/poingstudios/godot/admob/ads/PoingGodotAdMobAdView.kt
- https://github.com/poingstudios/godot-admob-android/blob/v4.0.0/src/ads/src/main/java/com/poingstudios/godot/admob/ads/adformats/Banner.kt
- https://github.com/poingstudios/godot-admob-plugin/blob/v4.0.1/addons/admob/src/api/AdView.gd#L47

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)


Clone: https://github.com/poingstudios/godot-admob-plugin
Follow the documentation: https://poingstudios.github.io/godot-admob-plugin/stable/

(Enable the plugin -> It will automatically download and install -> Enable Gradle build -> Export and test (The banner won't load))
